fact.claim: If you owe tax and the CRA gets your return after the due date, it charges 5% of the balance owing. It then adds 1% of the balance owing for each full month the return is late, for up to 12 months. If you were already penalized in one of the 3 years before and got a demand to file, the penalty goes up to 10% plus 2% a month for up to 20 months. The deadline is April 30, or the next business day if April 30 falls on a weekend or holiday. Filing on time avoids this penalty even if you can't pay yet. The page shows April 30, 2026 for 2025 taxes, and no CRA page I opened lists the 2027 date yet.
